npcs.name: Dartz
npcs.help:
The ancient king of Atlantis and leader of the Doma organisation, who has lived ten thousand years.

With The Seal of Orichalcos he seals the souls of the Duelists he defeats, to awaken the Great Leviathan.

lines.0:
So you have come.
Then let the Orichalcos judge you.
lines.9: You have walked into my trap.
lines.15:
You dare lay a hand on
the king of Atlantis?
lines.17:
Ten thousand years I have waited.
Behold the power of the Orichalcos!
lines.20:
Why do you hesitate?
Your fate was sealed
the moment you came here.
lines.21: Do not think this is over.
lines.24:
Rise, @@m!
Crush them in the name
of the Orichalcos!
lines.25:
So, another Duelist
has found their way to me.
lines.26:
I am Dartz,
king of Atlantis.
I have watched humanity for
ten thousand years.
lines.27:
Show me the light
in your heart.
lines.28:
And if it is weak,
the Seal will take your soul.
lines.31:
Good.
Your soul is still yours to lose.
lines.35:
Hm…
You have more strength
than I thought.
lines.36:
You are not yet worthy
of my attention.
Begone.
lines.37:

another soul.
lines.43:
Your soul belongs
to the Orichalcos now.
lines.47:
Close?
I was never in danger.
lines.53:

chosen between us.
lines.54:

the Seal will decide.

will not forget this.

npcs.name: Rafael
npcs.help:
One of the Three Dark Gods' own, a silent Duelist who commands the Guardians of the gods.

He fights with a strong sense of honour, and tests his challengers with the full might of his Guardian monsters.

You have come to face me.
Then I will show you the
strength of the Guardians.

My Guardians will not
be shaken so easily.
lines.17:
Hear me, Guardians!
Lend me all your strength!
lines.20:
You cannot break
the Guardians' bond.
lines.24:
Rise, @@m!
Guardian of the gods,
bring justice!
lines.25:
You seek a duel?
Then prove your resolve.
lines.26:
I am Rafael.
I fight with the Guardians
at my side.
lines.27:
Show me your heart,
and I will show you mine.
lines.35:
You are stronger than
I believed.
lines.36:
I have no time
for strangers. Leave.
lines.47:
Close? I did not
feel it so.
lines.62:
You have won...
The Guardians honour you.
lines.73:
You earned this
through your own will.
lines.78:
I will not lose
a second time.
lines.85:
The Guardians will
watch over you.

npcs.name: Valon
npcs.help:
A street-wise brawler from the rough side of town, who has fought for everything he owns.

Valon duels in Armor monsters and equips them up for the fight, and he is never shy of a scrap.

lines.35:

npcs.name: Alister
npcs.help:
A cold and calculating Duelist who commands an army of machines from his flying fortress.

Alister fights with tanks and cannons, and he waits for the moment his fortress, Air Fortress Ziggurat, can arrive.

npcs.name: Noah Kaiba
npcs.help:
The brilliant young mind who built a whole virtual world, and rules over it as its master.

Noah plays with a bold mix of monsters and traps, and his greatest card is Shinato, King of a Higher Plane.

The insect master who won fame in Duelist Kingdom, and has never lost his love for bugs.

Weevil swarms the field with insects and parasites, and he is not shy of playing dirty to win.

npcs.name: Zigfried von Schroeder
npcs.help:
The young heir to the Schroeder Corporation, who has trained since childhood to be a master Duelist.

Zigfried fights with the noble Fairies and Warriors of the Nibelung, and he waits for the moment to bring his power to bear.

npcs.name: Odion
npcs.help:
The loyal guardian of the Ishtar family, who stands before his master's tomb with his Trap cards.

Odion is calm and patient, and he lures his challengers into the traps of the Embodiment of Apophis.

lines.0:
You have come,
@@s.
Let us duel.
lines.20:
There is no escape
from the tomb.
lines.24:
Rise, @@m!
Protect the one I serve!
lines.25:
You have come.
I cannot let you pass.
lines.26:
I am Odion,
guardian of the tomb.
lines.27:
I will protect my master
with my life.
lines.31:
Then I must
stop you again.
lines.36:
I cannot let you pass.
Go.

npcs.name: Mako Tsunami
npcs.help:
The sea's own Duelist, a champion of the ocean who fights with his Fish and the power of the Umi.

Mako Tsunami is cheerful and tough, and he drags his opponents right to the bottom of the sea.

lines.0:
Ahoy, @@s!
The sea is calling!
Let's duel!
lines.6: Feel the power of the sea!
lines.17:
Hear the ocean roar!
Here comes the
big wave!
lines.20:
Come on!
The sea won't wait!
lines.24:
Rise, @@m!
And bring the power
of the sea!
lines.25:
Hey, matey!
Want to take on
the sea?
lines.26:
I'm Mako Tsunami!
The sea is my home,
and the fish are my crew.
lines.27:
I'll take you
right to the bottom.
lines.36:
Go away!
I've no time to spare.
lines.43:
You can't beat
the power of the sea!
lines.53:
The tide will turn
next time.
lines.62:
You won?!
The sea is angry now...
lines.73:
Here, take it.
You earned it.
